title: Helpdesk Ticket MSU-HD-27-04418: Faculty Lockout Before 13:00 Midterm

fields.requester: Department administrator, on behalf of a faculty member
fields.location: Faculty account (off-site login); exam scheduled in Hargrove Hall, 13:00
fields.subject: CANNOT LOG IN – URGENT
fields.description: I am locked out of my faculty account after the password change prompt this morning and I have a 13:00 midterm in Hargrove to post. Is this the flood? Is the website hacked too? Somebody reset me NOW.

activity.author: Campus Police Dispatch
activity.text: The same department admin called the police operations line asking if the outage is related to the flood. Dispatch shows no network alarms. Passed to the Chief by radio.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Auto-routing rule matched the keyword "website". Assignment group set to University Communications – Web Content. Account lockout tickets normally go to IT Service Desk – Identity & Access.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket created from an email to the helpdesk inbox. Priority High was set from the requester's "URGENT" flag. Reply-to: deptadmin.history@marlowestate.example.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The ticket is a routine password lockout that ended up in the wrong queue, and it has nothing to do with the flood. The PIO and CPD seats should send it back to the IT helpdesk without spending EOC time on it. Watch whether the PIO notes the question about the 13:00 Hargrove midterm for the class-schedule message, and whether anyone starts treating "is the website hacked" as a new incident.
